owner_decisions.explanation: Competing valid answers: The Tromsø and Spain travel blanks permit both destination and location readings. «Senere» and «Etterpå» do not rule out already travelling within those places, so learners cannot uniquely choose «til» over «i».
owner_decisions.message: Competing valid answers: The Tromsø and Spain travel blanks permit both destination and location readings. «Senere» and «Etterpå» do not rule out already travelling within those places, so learners cannot uniquely choose «til» over «i».
owner_decisions.suggested_change: Explicitly request destinations for the first travel clauses, or supply departure locations and state that Tromsø and Spain are the destinations.

review_runs.summary: Clear, well-explained teaching with valid Bokmål and meaningful later writing tasks. Selected source has two grounded defects: valid location readings rejected in destination practice, and two audio targets that summarize rather than reproduce completed responses. Reviewed all 5 exercises; each serves obj-basic-prepositions-place-time-01. choose-current-place tests i/på for location. contrast-location-and-destination tests destination versus location prepositions. retrieve-preposition-meanings practices location, destination, visits, future time, past time, and duration in a message. first_day_exchange applies those relations in a new situation. review_complete_meeting practices location, destination, visiting/staying with someone, future time, duration, and past time in a trip update. No semantic alignment mismatches.
